body.purpose: The flowing essay at desktop scale; sizes track the CSS breakpoints and Pretext measurement exactly.

instruction.purpose: The single loud line, first viewport only.

empty-state.purpose: The prompt shown when the visitor empties the text.

label.purpose: Control labels, counter, pad group label.

hint.purpose: One-line help under controls and the reset scope note.

motion.name: ease-out-system
motion.purpose: All UI state transitions and entrances.

motion.name: duration-disc
motion.purpose: Disc hover/drag scale only; placement never transitions.

invariants: Reflow is direct manipulation: never animate text movement or stagger fragments.
Exclusion radius = disc radius + 12px gap; glyphs never enter the gap.
Hover effects only under (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
prefers-reduced-motion removes transforms and keeps plain fades.
Controls keep ≥3:1 boundaries on the surface (Two-Border Rule); hairlines are decoration only.
Under pointer: coarse every control is a ≥44px touch target.

components.name: Button
components.description: Default control on the tool rail and in the editor. Paper fill, 3:1 control border, 8px corners.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #202128; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #868b9b; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #666b78; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5639d9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Affirming action inside the editor (Apply text). Ink fill, paper text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #ffffff; background: #202128; border: 1px solid #202128; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #33353f; border-color: #33353f; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5639d9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle Button (pressed)
components.description: The layout-view toggle keeps the button shape and turns violet when pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-toggle { font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: #5639d9; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #5639d9; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5639d9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Obstacle Disc
components.description: The movable circle: the single solid violet object, pointer-dragged, arrow-key movable.
components.html: <button class="ds-disc" aria-label="The circle. Drag it, or use the arrow keys to move it."></button>
components.css: .ds-disc { width: 144px; height: 144px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: #5639d9; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; user-select: none; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-disc:hover { transform: scale(1.03); } .ds-disc:active { cursor: grabbing; transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-disc:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #202128; outline-offset: 6px; }

components.name: Size Slider
components.description: Native range input with the violet accent; label in the 13px Label style.
components.css: .ds-range { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #565b66; } .ds-range input[type="range"] { width: 100%; accent-color: #5639d9; }

components.name: Text Area
components.description: Draft editor for the essay text. Paper fill, control border, violet caret and focus outline.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="4" spellcheck="false">We tend to think that reading happens where the words are.</textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.5; color: #202128; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #868b9b; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; caret-color: #5639d9; } .ds-textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5639d9; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Line Fragment (layout view)
components.description: One laid-out line as an absolutely positioned span, outlined with the available interval it was given.
components.html: The circle does not erase anything.
components.css: .ds-frag { display: inline-block; white-space: pre; font-family: "Source Sans 3", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 24px; line-height: 35px; color: #202128; outline: 1px dashed rgba(32, 33, 40, 0.3); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: The page is a working typesetter’s table, cleared of everything but one broad sheet of text and a single instrument for moving it. Cool near-white ground, charcoal humanist sans-serif at reading scale, one solid violet disc. The text is the exhibit; the tool rail is visibly secondary and never dresses up. The world is flat and optical rather than material: no paper textures, no shadows, no glass, no decorative gradients. Depth comes from tone and hairlines only, and motion is confined to direct manipulation.
keyCharacteristics: One continuous essay rendered as positioned line fragments; the layout itself is the work.
A single saturated accent reserved for the disc, active states, and focus.
Flat surfaces; hairlines for divisions; dashed strokes only for explanatory geometry.
Motion under 300 ms, transform/opacity only, never applied to the reflow itself.
Responsive by recomposition (type scale and rail arrangement change), never by shrinking.

rules.name: The One Violet Rule
rules.body: Specimen Violet appears only on the obstacle, active/selected states, focus indicators, links, and explanatory geometry. It is never used as a background wash or decoration.

rules.name: The Two-Border Rule
rules.body: Hairlines are decoration; controls carry the darker control border. A control must never be identified by a decorative hairline.

rules.name: The Measured-Type Rule
rules.body: Flowing text uses whole-pixel font sizes and explicit px line-heights that are identical for CSS and canvas measurement. If the type scale changes, the measurement changes with it.

dos: Do keep Specimen Violet to the disc, active states, focus, links, and explanatory strokes.
Do keep CSS type metrics and Pretext measurement in lockstep; re-prepare when text, font size, or line height changes.
Do keep pointer-tracked movement instant and put micro-interaction timing at 140–180ms with the system ease.
Do hide hover effects behind @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine).
Do keep every explanatory stroke 1px dashed so it reads as annotation, not chrome.
donts: Don’t add shadows, gradients, glass, textures, or card containers; the system is flat by decision.
Don’t animate the text reflow, stagger fragment entrances, or add autonomous motion; reflow is direct feedback.
Don’t let the disc’s exclusion zone overlap glyphs — the 12px gap is the invariant that keeps the composition readable.
Don’t use sub-44px touch targets for the pad on touch layouts.
Don’t let controls depend on color alone; every state pairs color with a border, outline, or text change.
